snr_definition: v2: noise_std = std(demeaned_channel) * 10^(-SNR_dB/20), immune to per-channel DC offset
note: Supersedes the v1 (raw-signal-RMS, DC-offset-contaminated) definition. v1 results are kept as an "extreme degradation" annex at noise_sensitivity_rms_with_dc_bias_ANNEX.json — under v1, nominal 20dB already injected noise far exceeding channels' true informative variation due to large per-channel DC bias, which is why v1 showed a cliff at the mildest tested level rather than a graded degradation curve.
